## Change

Describe the user or operational outcome and the smallest relevant scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Browser/accessibility tests run when UI or routing changed
- [ ] No secrets, local environment files, signing keys or production data are included
- [ ] Database migrations are additive/idempotent and rollback/restore impact is documented
- [ ] Privacy, security and legal impact reviewed where applicable

## Release impact

- Risk level: low / medium / high
- Migration required: yes / no
- Environment variables or secrets changed: yes / no
- Rollback procedure:
- Evidence/run links:
